channel.title: Crypto Docket
channel.description: Crypto Docket reports news across crypto: Bitcoin and Ethereum, layer-2 networks, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and security incidents.

item.title: fermi swap vs AMM routes: the wallet integration trade-off
item.description: Fermi swap gives wallet users a direct token-exchange option, while AMM routing can compare pools; the choice shifts control, complexity and execution.

item.title: XMR bridge swaps hinge on three address checks
item.description: An XMR bridge can move value across chains, but a swap is only as sound as its source, destination and refund addresses; verify each and its network before signing.
